verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Spirit of wisdom, open my eyes again
Spirit of revelation, open my heart again
'Cause I want to see You
Lord, I want to see
See You rightly, Jesus

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I know that Your eyes are like flames of fire
I know that Your head is white as wool
I know that Your voice it sounds like waters
Jesus, You're beautiful

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
Jesus, You're beautiful
Jesus, You're beautiful

verse.name: c3
verse.lines:
There is none like You, Lord
Jesus, You're beautiful

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
There is no one like You
In the heavens or on the earth

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Spirit of wisdom, open our eyes again
Spirit of revelation, open our hearts again
